647-751-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
3967-6972-7932.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5078-7902-7913.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

3480-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3480-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3480-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

240-3967-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4067-6281-6893-7327.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-6281-6893-7327.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

3398-6866.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Fire Lord Zuko.
3398-6866.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Fire Lord Zuko as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Fire Lord Zuko trigger, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

282-1756-3073-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-1756-3073-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering them each twice.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Reservoir Walker that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Reservoir Walker token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E} and gain at least 3 life.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

1110-3310-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
1110-3310-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the creature's power.
War Elemental's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

1636-4117-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Visara the Dreadful does not have summoning sickness.
"Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
1636-4117-4302-4875.description:
Activate Visara the Dreadful by tapping it, destroying another creature you control.
When the creature dies as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

141-2438-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

228-678-1069-4336.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
228-678-1069-4336.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Kobolds of Kher Keep dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai

1636-2098-2757-4039-5077.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
1636-2098-2757-4039-5077.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Scaretiller, targeting a basic land you control.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Vesuva from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gods' Eye.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability from step 1, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2682-4475-4705.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
2682-4475-4705.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the second Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1124-1367-2032-3326-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a Planeswalker spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1124-1367-2032-3326-5131.description:
Cast Kiora from your graveyard by paying {2}{G/U}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora using Kasmina's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Kiora using Kasmina's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to search for library for Nexus of Fate, exile it, then cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, allowing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffling Nexus of Fate into your library.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Kiora by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Kiora dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Kiora trigger, untapping a permanent.
Repeat.

1778-2882-4675.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1778-2882-4675.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

224-433-1362.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

65-615-717-1583-2628.description:
Activate Drifting Meadow's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Drifting Meadow, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Drifting Meadow trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Cartographer.
Cartographer enters the battlefield, returning Drifting Meadow from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
